description: Convert between a tax-free municipal bond yield and the equivalent taxable-bond yield given a marginal federal tax rate (plus an optional state rate, summed into a combined rate). With direction "tax-free-to-taxable", taxableYield = taxFreeYield / (1 - combinedRate); with "taxable-to-tax-free", taxFreeYield = taxableYield * (1 - combinedRate). Pure formula, no live bond pricing.

direction.description: Which yield the input represents and which to compute

federalTaxRatePercent.description: Marginal federal tax rate as a percent

inputYield.description: The known yield as a percent: the tax-free yield when direction is "tax-free-to-taxable", or the taxable yield when direction is "taxable-to-tax-free"

stateTaxRatePercent.description: Optional marginal state tax rate as a percent, summed with the federal rate

name: calculate_tax_equivalent_yield
